articles.title: Stellantis Turns to Microsoft AI Deal in Turnaround Push, But STLA Stock Lags
articles.mainIdea: Stellantis Turns to Microsoft AI Deal in Turnaround Push, But STLA Stock Lags
articles.summary: TipRanks: Stellantis Turns to Microsoft AI Deal in Turnaround Push, But STLA Stock Lags. European-American automaker Stellantis (STLA), which is plotting a turnaround of its business, has secured a five-year artificial intelligence deal with tech giant Microsoft (MSFT) “to enhance customer experiences.” However, the news failed to cheer investors, with the auto giant’s shares trading flat on Thursday morning.
